summary: netapp.ontap makes netapp-lib optional, adds REST-only automatic update support (ONTAP 9.10+), ASA r2 compatibility for LUN and NVMe modules, and a snapshot_policy option for S3 buckets (ONTAP 9.16.1+).
questions: Is netapp-lib still required for netapp.ontap?
Do netapp.ontap LUN modules support ASA r2?
How do I set a snapshot policy on an ONTAP S3 bucket with Ansible?

answer_card.title: netapp.ontap changes in Ansible 12
answer_card.answer_md:
- `netapp-lib` is now **optional**.
- `na_ontap_autoupdate_support`: REST-only automatic software update, ONTAP **9.10+**.
- ASA r2 compatibility: `na_ontap_lun`, `na_ontap_lun_map`, `na_ontap_lun_map_reporting_nodes`, `na_ontap_nvme_namespace`, `na_ontap_nvme_subsystem`; `na_ontap_lun_copy` refuses unsupported ASA r2 systems.
- `na_ontap_s3_buckets`: new `snapshot_policy` option (REST, ONTAP **9.16.1+**).
